name: academic-project-page
description: Build, polish, or audit an academic project page for GitHub Pages, then check it in a real browser.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a paper, figures and videos into a checked project page.
interface.longDescription: Builds a responsive project page for a paper, thesis or project from a folder of materials, in the style of the Academic Project Page Template and Nerfies, then checks it in a real browser. Also polishes or audits an existing page.
defaultPrompt: Make a project page for our paper from the materials in this folder.
Polish the project page in docs/ without changing the content.
Is the project page in docs/ ready to publish? Just tell me what's wrong.
